name: Kiryuu Hinaki
source:
She is the younger sister of the main character. Growing up she would always fight her older sister Yuzuha over their brother.

However, when the protagonist returns home, she treats him coldly and urges him to leave home as soon as possible.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=561925&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
